descriptor: open firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1
scope: Offline provenance, licence and recovery-asset inventory; no vendor build, firmware execution, device traffic, install, restore or distribution approval.

licensing.app: LICENSE.md states GPL-3.0-only with an additional linking permission for the named FM1 SDK.
licensing.third_party: THIRD_PARTY.md has component-level terms, including native engine binary terms for FM1 devices; some files retain separate notices.
licensing.boundary: The additional SDK permission is scoped to covered APP code; it does not authorize combining unrelated GPL components with proprietary SDK binaries.
licensing.policy: No vendor file is imported in this pilot. Review exact file notices and dependencies before any source reuse; this inventory is not distribution approval.

public_source: Public SDK headers and linker/package configuration

native_closed_runtime.finding: Single-member native archive with closed engine, sequencer, startup and platform/service symbols; no LLVM bitcode or DWARF.

build_inputs: Native build requires Windows x64, PowerShell and separately supplied JieLi PI32v2 clang 4.0.1 r3; external file hashes are listed but those tools are not bundled.
Web build uses WASI SDK 27; no build was run in this inventory.
A source URL shape check does not establish source completeness.

owner_historical_full_flash.provenance: Retained bench record reports matching copies and a previous complete stock-baseline restore/read-back.

limits: The public stock FWSC is not the owner's complete flash backup and supplies no entry transport.
Historical backup/restore evidence does not establish later interrupted stage7 contents or current device state.
Encrypted auxiliary plaintext CRCs were not independently validated; whole-package digest matched.

reuse_decision.finding: No compatible supported engine-free platform-only binary seam without vendor permissions is demonstrated.
reuse_decision.reason: The native APP links the closed engine archive; its exception does not cover unrelated GPL components, and exposed APP hooks do not establish Lunar's alternative-engine and timestamped MIDI/runtime boundary.
reuse_decision.direction: Keep Lunar's SDK-free GPL native direction; selectively reuse public source only after file-level notice and dependency review.

checks: safe archive paths; reject traversal, symlink/special files, duplicate normalized paths
verifier.limits: No downloads, vendor executable invocation or device access.
